summary.name: Tiki Wiki CMS Groupware
summary.one_liner: Tiki Wiki CMS Groupware is an open-source, community-managed web application for group collaboration, communication, and data management, developed since 2002.
use_cases: building web-based data input and management forms
summary.what_it_does: The page is the GitLab repository for Tiki Wiki CMS Groupware, a web application for group collaboration and communication, and for data input, management and presentation. The project states it has been continuously developed since 2002. Its design aims to include the most-needed components in the core code rather than relying on third-party plugins and extensions. Tiki is community-managed by the Tiki Software Community Association, a non-profit corporation. The repository accepts merge requests, and the page points to a guide on which branch to use.
notable: Most built-in features, with core components included rather than third-party plugins
Licensed LGPL-2.1 and written in PHP (from listing)
caveats: Page does not describe pricing or hosting options beyond the listing's mention of a demo
